name: The EXTREME Obby
desc:
The EXTREME Obby is one of the most challenging obbies on Roblox. Many people will not be able to handle its difficulty. Only 1% of professional Roblox obbyists can win... do you have what it takes?

CONTROLS (Computer, Console):
- Reset Character (R, Y)
- Shift Lock (Shift, LT)
- Rotate Camera 45 degrees (Comma/Period, LB/RB)
